name: Cian Cúldub
text: Cian Cúldub appears in the Irish legends as a hero attached to Leinster. His name is Irish and carries the sense of the black hair. The source records him in a single line, without deeds. Tradition preserves just his homeland and the meaning of his name.

attributes.attribute: name means of the black hair

okr.objective: Cian Cúldub is a one-line Leinster entry in the dictionary of Irish legend.
key_results: Place him in Leinster as a hero.
Give the sense of his name as of the black hair.
Note that the source records him in one line.
okr.evidence: MacKillop, Dictionary of Celtic Mythology, s.v. 'Cian Cúldub'
